method: Fit policy over nine classes of 0.32-second displacement and a conditional native-key motor. Targets require measured control of an uninterrupted interval without a source debit or observed HP loss. High-level inputs are current causal features only, with an unweighted behavior support mask. Train all actors on issued keys using measured four-second advantages cut at handoffs and frozen model-assisted one-step value. Distill from causal inputs into the ordinary native actor. Opening frozen.
controls: Training-goal permutation within a fight and matched current horizontal speed, vertical speed and grounding.
Direct 79-key advantage-weighted policy on the same data, optimizer, representation, takeover sampling and deployment loss, with a constant motor code.
nominate: Require advantage over the frozen T directions and both same-budget controls on actually issued teacher takeovers after student control: total direction matches improve and a strict majority of at least three supported whole held fights improve versus each matched control. At most one percentage point lost in ordinary teacher direction and positive mean return-weighted executed-key log probability shift in at least three teacher-free held fights. One real cohort 9988000+ after existing cohorts if accepted. Offline metrics cannot establish causal safety or acceptance.
inference: Use distilled raw-history actor on the game PC. No future displacement, future health, teacher route, or planner is a runtime input.
